a Grug Digital game
SHOP
Touch: in the Depot, your left thumb moves and the Jump button jumps · drag anywhere to turn the camera, pinch to zoom · in a zone, tap a card, then tap a lit tile
The Depot: WASD move · Space jump · Q / E or right-drag turn the camera · wheel zoom. Walk onto a zone's grid to take the job
A run: head north from the Depot. Each zone is its own walled-in location with a grid in the middle; clear its job and the gate at the far end opens. Your deck and energy come with you, and you get a free card (or energy) for every zone you clear. Lose a job and the run is over
A job: catch the quota of pets before the shift ends. Each day you get to play every card in your deck once, in any order: 1-7 or click a card, then click a lit tile. Esc or right-click cancels. Enter / Space ends the day
Night: every pet grows one stage. BABY → GROWN → EGG. If an egg is still there when night falls, it hatches into a stampede and the run is over. Catch a baby for a Rare, a grown one for an Epic, an egg for a Common (it hatches into a random pet)
Cards: Movement, Attack and Utility. Walk and run moves pass over tiles (and pick up energy on the way) but can't climb a hill. Hops, jumps and leaps can, and landing on a pet from a hill catches it outright. Teleports go anywhere in range
Height: hills are 8 studs up. Only lobbed zaps reach a pet above you, and a hill blocks a beam fired from the ground. From a hill, beams and swipes hit bugs below
Energy: cells drop onto the field in ones and twos every day. Walk over one to pick it up (your wallet holds 10). Spend it in the Module Shop: the new card replaces one in your deck, used or not, and is ready right away. A lobbed shot on a cell blows it up and zaps every pet next to it
Burrows: dirt mounds show where pets will pop up tonight. Stand on one and nothing comes up
